description.en:
Alpaca PRX500: a large alpaca barn with its own covered fleece pallet shed.
A place to keep your alpacas, with a pasture you can customize. - Holds at least 100 alpacas - Shearing spot in the old milking stall - Fleece comes out as pallets inside the Open Wooden Garage, open side facing the barn - Food: grass and hay, the same as sheep on any map (including alfalfa, clover and map crops); meadow counts the same as grass; 360,000 l - Straw bedding: 120,000 l, used up per day like pigs; production 110% when full down to 85% when empty (no manure, no slurry) - Automatic water supply (you pay for the water used) - No milk production - Optional solar panels on the barn and the garage (one option) - 13 colour choices
Price: $268,200 | Upkeep: $268/day Shop: Animal Pens > Alpacas
Requires the Beans & Alpacas DLC. Uses the base-game Hörmann models, no extra textures.
